name: Trapezoid-based Radiance Integration in Box Coordinates
aliases: Analytic Integration of Unoccluded Single Scattering in Box-Shaped Medium
definition: A method for integrating unoccluded radiance in a homogeneous finite medium by traversing the intersection of a light-view plane with a bounding box, decomposing the path into trapezoid segments to analytically compute the integral over transmittance.
